summary.topic: A miniature playroom and character activities
summary.learning_goal: Present a warm toy-room scene with selectable activities; no explicit subject lesson is shown.
summary.primary_visualization: Open isometric room with play mat, slide, furniture and a moving child character.
summary.primary_interaction: Demo rotates the room, follows character activity and opens an activity panel.

strengths: Room objects and activity locations are visually recognizable.
weaknesses: No explicit factual lesson or developmental validity is evidenced.

strengths: Different toy areas offer a potential spatial context for activity-based learning.
weaknesses: Character play and changing activities are not tied to explanation, prediction or a learning goal.

strengths: Open walls and elevated camera keep floor objects and large play equipment visible.
weaknesses: Furniture and toys are attractive but primarily illustrative.

strengths: The activity panel and character positions change across the recording.
weaknesses: The character also moves autonomously; not every movement can be attributed to a user action.

strengths: Warm restrained palette and compact peripheral controls create a coherent miniature scene.
weaknesses: Small controls and pale text are harder to distinguish; mobile behavior is unknown.

top_strengths: Different toy areas offer a potential spatial context for activity-based learning.
Open walls and elevated camera keep floor objects and large play equipment visible.
Warm restrained palette and compact peripheral controls create a coherent miniature scene.
top_weaknesses: No explicit factual lesson or developmental validity is evidenced.
Character play and changing activities are not tied to explanation, prediction or a learning goal.
The character also moves autonomously; not every movement can be attributed to a user action.
principles_to_learn: Use open-sided isometric rooms to expose spatial activity zones.
Place contextual labels near the active object.
Hide secondary activity choices until requested.
things_not_to_copy: Do not treat cute animation as evidence of child learning.
Do not attribute autonomous motion to meaningful user control.
golden_recommendation: Provisional demo reference. Use for isometric room, contextual activity, progressive disclosure. Live behavior remains unverified.
